name: Quality Snack Foods Inc
old_description: Quality Snack Foods, Inc. was started in 1986 in the stockyards area of Chicago, Illinois. The company was founded to manufacture pork rinds and pork crackling pellets. In 1990 we moved to our second location in Chicago’s “Back of the yards” neighborhood. Giving the company the space and ability to “Pop and Pack “a wide variety of snacks, in addition to giving us more than 90 years’ experience in the meat and snack food industry. The company moved again in 2008 to a new 105,000 sq ft state of the art facility in Alsip, Illinois. Here we significantly increased our production capabilities to manufacture pork products, wheat/harina products and pre-cooked bacon for the food service industry.
about:
Quality Snack Foods Inc. began in 1986 in Chicago's historic stockyards district, founded to produce pork rinds and crackling pellets. The operation relocated in 1990 to the city's Back of the Yards neighborhood, expanding its "pop and pack" capabilities. In 2008 the company moved into a 105,000-square-foot, USDA-inspected facility in Alsip, Illinois, where it remains headquartered.

The Alsip plant houses state-of-the-art cookers, fryers, and packaging lines that turn out pork rinds, cracklings, chicken-skin snacks, chicharrones, fried harina (wheat-flour snacks), and pre-cooked bacon for food-service channels. The vertically integrated operation controls every step from raw-material sourcing through seasoning, frying, and final packaging, allowing flexible run sizes and custom seasoning blends.

Primary customers are private-label brands, food-service distributors, and wholesale buyers across the United States. The company's bacon products are tailored for pizza toppings, salads, appetizers, and even novelty items such as bacon-topped donuts, while its pork-rind and harina lines serve retail snack aisles and keto-focused markets.

Quality Snack Foods emphasizes its SQF certification, on-site USDA inspection, and the "Quality" name as a commitment to consistent product safety and cleanliness. The founders' collective 90-plus years in meat and snack processing underpin the company's focus on vertical integration as a means to maintain strict quality control from source to shelf.
